settings_policy: All baseline definitions and fixed hyperparameters were declared before running calibration event labels. Generic baselines fit only development verified-quiet data and calibrate one event threshold only on calibration verified-quiet exposure. Detector 0.4 and physics-ML v1.0 retain their frozen operating points. No calibration event label is used for method or threshold selection.
shorten_reproducibility_note: shorten-op-pf-surrogate preserves the optimal-proposal Gaussian update, predictive-density anomaly statistic, ESS-triggered systematic resampling, regularisation bandwidth and residual-derived Q/R convention, but replaces the paper-specific non-standard mean-element SGP4/Kozai-Brouwer implementation with a nonsingular empirical mean-element transition fitted only on development verified-quiet data. It is therefore a structural surrogate, not an exact reproduction.
